## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List exact checks and device/API/codec details where relevant. Include synthetic before/after screenshots for visible changes. Explain skipped checks and remaining limits.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused; relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] `./scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] Relevant device tests were run, or the reason they were not is documented.
- [ ] Project format/preview/export compatibility was considered.
- [ ] No private media, credentials, signing material, or proprietary assets are included.
